Who this is for

Four situations we solve every week

Most people arrive with one of these. Each has a documented route to a finished degree.

01You dropped outCredit transferCompleted semesters are carried across, so you resume rather than restart.
02You are working full timeStudy around the jobNo attendance requirement and no fixed class hours. Your employer never has to know.
03You have hit a ceilingA recognized degreeThe qualification most promotion and salary bands are gated on, completed alongside the job.
04You are sitting for government examsUPSC and PSC eligibleDegrees from UGC recognized universities. Eligibility for a given post follows that exam’s notification.

Not sure which one you are?

A counselor will map it in twenty minutes, free.

Working process

From first call to enrolment in 48 hours

  1. 01Day 0

    Talk to a counselor

    A 20-minute call. We map your existing credits, your gap years and your goal to the right program.

  2. 02Day 1

    Submit documents

    Marksheets, ID and photographs. We verify eligibility and confirm credit transfer where it applies.

  3. 03Within 48 hours

    Enrolment confirmed

    The university issues your enrolment number. Fees can be split into monthly instalments from here.

  4. 042–3 years

    Study and graduate

    Learn at your own pace around work. Assessment is continuous no sit-down examination hall.
